name: olae-site-checks
description: DOM-level checks for the instruments that run in the browser. Run `bundle exec jekyll build` first: the service-worker check reads the rendered _site/sw.js. Development only, and scripts/ is excluded from the Jekyll build, so none of this is published.

scripts.test: node scripts/test-pdfjs.mjs && node scripts/test-reader-pdf.cjs && node scripts/test-let-it-snow.cjs && node scripts/test-puzzle-mode.cjs && node scripts/test-service-worker.cjs
